mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of tightening above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals a severe labor market weakening, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of unemployment above 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 700 billion USD signals a severe demand contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of severe consumption decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% and a 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 700 billion USD signals a severe labor market and demand contraction, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: severe labor market and demand contraction
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of severe unemployment and consumption decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 700 billion USD signals a severe demand contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of severe consumption decline (t-test p > 0.05).
